title: Gerda Henkel Foundation: PhD Scholarships
summary: PhD scholarships for junior academics in historical sciences supporting doctoral theses in Germany. Covers monthly base amount and additional benefits with flexible application deadlines.

subject_areas.notes: Historical sciences and related fields such as archaeology, historical Islamic studies, history of art, history of law, prehistory and early history, history of science.

mandatory.text: Final grade for the degree (Master's, for state examinations: Sec. II) must be 1.5 or higher.
Applicants must not be older than 27 years at the time of concluding their Master's studies.

funding.description: Scholarship base amount: 1,920 EUR per month. Additional benefits such as travel allowance, material costs, and family allowance (480 EUR for academics with one child, +120 EUR for each additional child) if applicable.
funding.duration: between 12 to 24 months (extension of up to 12 months possible)

application_rounds.notes: Applications may be submitted at any time.

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications may be submitted at any time.

steps.text: Submit application through the application portal using a desktop computer.

sources.title: Gerda Henkel Foundation: PhD Scholarships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship supports doctoral candidates for research/study towards a PhD in historical sciences, applicable internationally.
